description: V6 (raw Speed against Trick Room Speeds in Champions). stance-change-raw-speed under Trick Room, with Clefable (Multiscale, Speed 80) slower than Metagross (Friend Guard, Speed 122): Aegislash's forme change leaves `pokemon.speed` at the raw stored Speed 80, which Trick Room does not touch, while the others carry their negated Speeds (-80, -122). The ModifyDamage handlers sort by that: Expert Belt (80), Multiscale (-80), Friend Guard (-122), and the chain 4915, 2048, 3072 gives 1844/4096. With the base game's `10000 - speed` the raw 80 would sort last (Multiscale, Friend Guard, Expert Belt: 1843/4096).
